observed_target: 96 fixed 15-minute bins in Asia/Seoul civil CLOCK for every same station and date, not re-binned differently per candidate
scoring: Conditional multinomial log probability of identical observed civil-bin counts given per-station-day total and independently observed device uptime, averaged equally over held-out physical sites, compared with same uniform-civil-time exposure baseline.
coordinate_rate_convention: Each candidate parameterizes an event-time DENSITY per model-coordinate hour. Civil intensity is f(coord(t))*abs(dcoord/dcivil). Camera uptime is integrated in CIVIL time with this Jacobian. Do not compare scores from different response partitions.

astronomy_context.average_anchor: average sunrise and sunset from the unchanged 82 public-astronomy matched days, frozen before outcomes

candidate_models.description: civil time corrected for date-specific astronomical local noon; J=1
double anchor sunrise→6 solar h and sunset→18 solar h, piecewise Jacobian
date-specific sunrise/sunset mapped to across-frozen-date mean sunrise/sunset; piecewise Jacobian
same solar-phase map but separate precommitted rising and falling branch peak parameters

integration.method: 8-point Gauss-Legendre separately split by device interval bounds, sunrise/sunset and civil bin edges

training_testing.heldout_metric: equal-site average log score per detected event in identical 15-minute civil bins

required_safety_tests: all candidates use same civil 96-bin outcomes
all predicted mass integrates with correct Jacobian and is normalized over actual civil operation
full day phase/average anchor transforms map correctly at sunrise, sunset and midnight
positive count at zero uptime rejected
solar_phase_plus_branch adds season parameters but does not relabel a season effect as photoperiod memory
all 41 pairs unchanged and 32 physical sites heldout independently of outcomes
clock and solar candidate comparison cannot use transformed-event likelihood on different time partitions
report all five generating processes including weakly distinguishable pairs; no posthoc model/window winner selection
source original camera operation data and wildlife detections untouched
